source.notes: ISC Class XI school half-yearly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Half Yearly Examination 2018-2019', 'Chemistry', 'Class : XI', 'Time : 3Hrs.+15min.', 'Full Marks : 70'; examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 195 = 3 h + 15 min as printed. The PDF is a 4-sheet landscape booklet imposition: each PDF page holds two printed pages (PDF 1 = printed 8 | 1, PDF 2 = 2 | 7, PDF 3 = 6 | 3, PDF 4 = 4 | 5), so questions were reassembled in printed-page order; 'page' is the PDF page where the question starts. The PDF has a real text layer (used), checked line by line against the rendered pages. Instructions print: 'Question 1 is of 20 marks having four sub-parts, all of which are compulsory. Question No. 2 to 8 carry 2 marks each having two internal choices. Q. 9 to 15 carry 3 marks each having two internal choices. Q. 16 to 16 carry 5 marks each all of which has internal choices.' ('16 to 16' as printed; Q16-Q18 are taken as 5 marks each, which makes the total 70). Q1 is split into its printed sub-parts; Q2-Q18 are kept whole. Q2, Q7, Q12, Q13, Q16, Q17 and Q18 have OR choices (alternatives labelled (a)/(b) by the editor). Q12's structures are hand-drawn and not reproduced. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
